(1) anti-slop/require-safety-comment-for-type-assertion in next/apps/fabrika: 4 casts `Object.keys(paths) as ReadonlyArray<Law>` in next/apps/fabrika/src/exam/agents.test.ts became Effect's `Struct.keys(paths)`, which types the keys itself, so no cast and no SAFETY comment is left. A Schema decode was written and worked, but its effect import made pnpm format's lint report 7 blocking fabrika/no-raw-try-catch hits on the script, so it was reverted; Predicate.isString needs the same import. Until .agents/** joins that rule's block in .oxlintrc.json, lint reports this ignore as an unused directive (1 blocking). (5) next/apps/fabrika/src/door-spans.test.ts:299 decodes with `Schema.decodeSync(Input)` in place of `decodeUnknownSync`, as effect(preferTypedSchemaDecoder) asks; the decode and its throw are unchanged. No law, assertion or rule was weakened, and .oxlintrc.json and both ledger files were not changed. Second round, after main's PR 1427 was merged in (head 50babbf62): its new next/packages/libfabrika/src/settings/App.test.ts had 4 hits in a folder the old lock covered. (6) anti-slop-effect/prefer-effect-match at :321 (expected value and origin by `place`), :560 (the repo file's text by `place`) and :861 (the source named in the message by `source`): each became `Match.value(...).pipe(Match.when(...))`, with `Match.orElse` and the old last branch for `place`, and `Match.exhaustive` for `source`, whose four cases repo, person, env and flag are all listed. (7) anti-slop/no-runtime-typeof at :539: the `printed` helper's JSON.stringify replacer asks `Predicate.isBigInt(v)` in place of `typeof v === "bigint"`, with the same answer. No ignore line in this round, and the folder's other anti-slop counts did not change. Third round, after the first review sent the pull request back (head 61d6f7895, review row field/runs/2026-11-18-antislop-judgment-1057-review1.json) for a copied helper (0040, 0587): the guard `(json: Schema.Json): json is Schema.JsonObject => Predicate.isObject(json)` was written four times in libfabrika, in runtime/Program.ts (from main), runtime/Patch.ts (`isObject`), runtime/Runner.ts (`isJsonObject`) and client/HandsStart.ts (`isTable`). (8) It is now one export, `isJsonObject`, in next/packages/libfabrika/src/runtime/Patch.ts, with a doc block and `@category guards`; Program.ts, Runner.ts and HandsStart.ts import it, and HandsStart.ts drops its unused Predicate import. Patch.ts was picked because it is the runtime module about JSON values and imports nothing from libfabrika, so no cycle forms, and layer-rules.json lets next-client import next-runtime, as client/Tezgah.ts already does from runtime/Patch.ts; a root file in next-shared would have needed a new layer-rules.json row. A search over next/ for `is Schema.JsonObject` found no fifth copy. The body is unchanged, so behavior is unchanged. (9) The review's finding row was saved unchanged as field/findings/2026-11-18-libfabrika-patch-hand-writes-effect-jsonpatch.json; field-check asked for no shape change.
